name: omp-studio
description: Desktop console for OMP Runtime — typed Studio Bridge, Electron workbench, Windows installer and macOS app
author: snowpear

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @omp-studio/renderer && npm run build -w @omp-studio/desktop && node scripts/bundle-remote-host.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @omp-studio/renderer && npm run typecheck -w @omp-studio/desktop
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:built
scripts.check: npm run check:selects && npm run build && npm run test:core
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @omp-studio/studio-protocol && npm run build -w @omp-studio/client-contract && npm run build -w @omp-studio/platform && npm run build -w @omp-studio/runtime-installer && npm run build -w @omp-studio/transport-desktop && npm run build -w @omp-studio/transport-web && npm run build -w @omp-studio/client && npm run build -w @omp-studio/platform-win32 && npm run build -w @omp-studio/platform-darwin && npm run build -w @omp-studio/studio-host && npm run build -w @omp-studio/host-client-api && npm run build -w @omp-studio/testkit
scripts.test:tooling: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @omp-studio/desktop && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
